verdict.rationale: ernd is a business charge card that companies sign up for to pay AI vendors and earn rewards. The story asks for card-issuing infrastructure that lets a founder launch their own card program (BIN sponsorship, network membership, program management), which is a different product role. Requesting an ernd card in a few minutes is about getting a card as a customer, not about issuing cards under your own program, so this axis does not apply.
